verdict: Accept19f as a bounded, modest work-in-progress increment; retain all production/perfect-match/rig/game approval flags false.

actual_visible_findings.front: Blue-eye face, headphones, front framing and outfit identity remain recognizable without a visible regression. All original records/bytes are preserved.
actual_visible_findings.three_quarter: Original front identity and luggage persist; new rear accents are largely occluded, so this is preservation evidence rather than proof of a full hairstyle repair.
actual_visible_findings.left_and_right_profiles: A few narrow tapered ends and curved lower-rear accents are now real volumes extending slightly past the existing bulb. The source silhouette remains broad; the shoulder/side-body textures remain blurred and irregular.
actual_visible_findings.back: Two broad flattened S reliefs and staggered ends read over the lower hair. The soft lavender candidate is compatible with the source palette, but central patches remain mottled and the underlying hair remains one merged large mass.
actual_visible_findings.gray: Real volume change is visible in mild gray views. It adds two accents over the source rather than replacing its main hair mass with separated sculpted clumps.
actual_visible_findings.reference_gap: Reference shows more separated, smoothly flowing locks, cleaner side layering and valleys exposing the coat; current source broad bulb and outer thin sheetlike fragments persist.

other_model_scope: Nine current frozen GLB inputs checked unchanged; no newly staged roster manifest existed when this report was written.
